caption: AI Sampling Parameters
description: The decoding and sampling configuration applied to a model invocation. These are configuration values that alter what a model will emit — part of the trust base — not runtime state: activations, logits, and cache contents are explicitly out of scope.
name: ai_sampling_params

max_output_tokens.description: The maximum output token limit applied.

seed.description: The sampling seed applied, when the runtime supports seeded decoding.
